_info: Content of aisanely.com. A scheduled task updates it after posts are approved.

posts.title: Claude in Copilot switches on for EU companies
posts.body: From 9 December, Microsoft turns on Anthropic's Claude models in Microsoft 365 Copilot for EU and EFTA organizations that haven't opted out.

posts.title: Ask AI to pick your idea apart
posts.body: AI tends to agree with you. Asking for criticism shows you the weak spots before you hit them.
posts.prompt: Here is my plan: [plan]. Be critical. Where could I be wrong, and what have I forgotten?

posts.title: Perplexity: AI search that shows sources
posts.body: Ask a normal question. Each sentence in the answer has a small number. Click it and you see where the information came from.

quiz.q: When you delete a chat, ChatGPT also forgets everything it remembered from it.
quiz.why: A saved memory stays. You have to delete it in Settings → Personalization → Memory too.

quiz.q: Your ChatGPT conversations can be used to improve the models, but you can turn that off.
quiz.why: In Settings → Data controls you can turn off "Improve the model for everyone".

quiz.q: When AI sounds confident, the answer must be true.
quiz.why: Language models can be wrong even when they sound convincing. Always check important information.
quiz.src: the notice under the ChatGPT chat box

quiz.q: Gemini is an AI assistant made by Google.
quiz.why: Gemini is developed by Google. OpenAI makes ChatGPT and Microsoft makes Copilot.
